newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Oerlikon unit sees oper profit rising.
newsitem.headline: Oerlikon unit sees oper profit rising.

text.p: Oerlikon Contraves Group, a unit of the Swiss conglomerate Oerlikon-Buehrle Holding AG, expects an increase in its operating profit in 1997 and for turnover to about match that of 1996, Contraves chief executive Ernst Odermatt said.
He also said operating profit and turnover during the first quarter of 1997 were about level with those of the first quarter last year.

Contraves has a turnover target of about 700 million Swiss francs by the year 2000, earnings before interest and taxes in excess of 70 million and a return on net assets of between 13 and 15 percent, Odermatt told reporters at a presentation of the company's weapons and space products.
Oerlikon Contraves had 1996 turnover of 702 million francs, profit before interest and taxes of 48 million and a return on net assets of 5.5 percent.
Odermatt also said Oerlikon Contraves expected defense to continue making up around 85 percent of its annual sales with space products accounting for the rest.
"These proportions will remain stable in the coming years," he told reporters.
